hypothesis: Original-curator tmQM repository bskjelstad/tmQM may document joint transition-metal-complex quantum properties with explicit data terms and structural IDs. This name is a lead, not verified provenance or suitability.
purpose: Identify at most one separate scientist-curated source whose README/license/schema documentation are directly available in a public GitHub repository. Compare documented rights/pairing/grouping with previously stopped routes; do not select a benchmark or target criteria.
prior_use_check: Bounded rg search for tmQM/Skjelstad/Alchemy and proposed paper DOI in published reports/docs Markdown and source/catalog JSON returned no matches. This is not global/model-training freshness evidence.
allowed_followups: Exactly one GitHub default-branch commit metadata request, using default_branch from repository metadata
Root file tree/contents metadata at the resulting exact commit
README and LICENSE/COPYING raw source at that exact commit, using literal returned paths
At most one explicitly linked data/schema README at that exact commit if root README lacks field definitions; no numeric data file
One exact Crossref DOI record for the primary paper explicitly cited by this repository; abstract and outcome performance withheld
transport: Ordinary HTTPS GET,30s timeout,no redirects,no retries,no credentials. Per-response cap1MiB for metadata/README/license;2MiB for root tree metadata. Preserve first failure. A403 stops the affected route without alternate API/host/mirror. No follow-up dataset or archive requests.
projection: Whole bounded repository metadata and selected documentary files are machine-read and may contain aggregate counts, code examples or result prose. Researcher first sees file names, section/table headings, literal identifiers, license declarations and citation metadata. Subsequent prose is limited to purpose, provenance, calculation conventions, paired field/schema/unit definitions, identity/grouping, missingness and terms; numerical target examples and outcome/leaderboard/performance sections are withheld. Documentary counts/units/method constants are permitted and labeled.
forbidden: Numeric CSV/XYZ/SDF/JSON dataset or archive download
A mirror or alternate access route around earlier denials
Full articles, figures, cited measurement tables or leaderboard values
Fits, target thresholds, feature selection, allocation or benchmark admission
retention: Exact request/status/time/body size/SHA and Git commit/blob metadata; raw unselected bodies remain ignored. Publish compact own paraphrase, selected factual schema/rights/identity, receipts, first failures and explicit unresolved gates. No arbitrary README examples/contact strings in public output.
